name: TG Intermediate Cleanup
description: Telegram: 最终结果发出后自动删除思考/工具调用/中间媒体卡片等过程消息，只保留最终答案（含其配图）；降级通知不再顶掉答案；删除失败自动重试或折叠为…；安装预检+失败安全，防止框架升级后误删。运行时 monkey-patch，qwenpaw 升级不受影响。

description_i18n.zh-CN: Telegram 中间过程消息自动清理 v1.0.0：最终结果发出后自动删除 💭思考、工具调用、中间图片/文件/卡片等过程消息，只保留最终答案及其媒体；出错/取消保留现场；框架接口变动时失效保护（宁可不清理，绝不误删答案）。
description_i18n.en-US: Telegram intermediate message cleanup v1.0.0: after the final reply is sent, automatically delete thinking/tool-call progress messages including intermediate media and cards, keeping the final answer and its attached media. Errors/cancellations preserve the scene. Fail-safe: skips cleanup when the answer cannot be identified instead of risking deletion.

author: hxx0611
